text: Your weight in twenties or your height in hundreds? One's a two hundred grand fuck-up.
Hundreds, right? Double-tap if so. Nope.
Average American guy, about a gram a bill: height in hundreds, one point six mil. Weight in twenties? One point eight.
Send this to whoever'd grab hundreds. They'd lose two hundred grand.
For once the damn scale pays you. So… weight or height?
